channel.title: Documentation | edaha.md
channel.description: Static site generator powered by TypeScript and markdown

item.title: Introduction
item.description: edaha.md is a static site generator written in TypeScript. It converts Markdown files into HTML pages and RSS feeds.

item.title: Quick start
item.description: This builds a small website with one news article, using as little configuration as possible. You need Node.js 22 or later.

item.title: Configuration
item.description: A config file tells edaha.md about your website, where its files are, and what to build for each type of article.

item.title: Articles
item.description: An article is a Markdown file with a short header of settings, in its own folder with its images and attachments.

item.title: Templating
item.description: edaha.md renders every page with Nunjucks templates. It comes with a neutral default theme, and you can replace any of its templates with your own, one file at a time.

item.title: Lists
item.description: A list is a collection of articles, newest first. edaha.md builds lists of each article type, and of its articles by tag and by author, each with its own RSS feed.

item.title: Embeds
item.description: Embeds turn a URL in an article into richer content, such as a video or a music player. They are like shortcodes in WordPress, or an HTML <iframe> you don’t have to write yourself.

item.title: Build & deploy
item.description: edaha build turns your articles into a folder of plain HTML, RSS and static files. Deploying is uploading that folder to any host that serves static files.

item.title: WYSIWYG editor
item.description: edaha.md comes with an editor that lets you write and manage your website’s articles in your browser, without editing Markdown files. What you see as you write is what your visitors will see.
